issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning String, while the solution implementation defines getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return int. The template leaves the method unimplemented, so students who follow the UML may implement a String-returning method and be confused when the intended/solution implementation (and likely tests) expects an int.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (or otherwise update the textual instructions to explicitly require an int return). Ensure the UML and problem text consistently specify an int return type so students implement the method matching the solution and tests.
